property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that exposes transferFrom(address,address,uint256), C always successfully calls that selector for each recipient and returns true; if the selector is wrong (0x00000000) some well-formed callees will not match and the overall transfer call will revert (or fail), so the mutant breaks this property for some inputs.
change_summary: Change bytes4 id = bytes4(keccak256(...)) to a different selector bytes4(0x00000000), causing the external calls to likely fail and revert while original succeeded (or vice versa).
